title: Saudi Arabia Awards $490M Contract for Museum of Contemporary Art at Historic Diriyah
detail: The Diriyah Company awarded a USD 490 million contract to build the Saudi Arabia Museum of Contemporary Art (SAMoCA), a flagship cultural institution spanning 77,000 square meters at the historic Dir'iyah site northwest of Riyadh. Designed by UAE-headquartered British firm Godwin Austen Johnson, the project represents a major milestone in MBS's cultural transformation agenda under Vision 2030. The museum is intended to position Saudi Arabia as a global cultural hub, complementing significant investments in arts, entertainment, and heritage tourism. Dir'iyah — the birthplace of the First Saudi State and a UNESCO World Heritage Site — is being developed as a multi-billion dollar heritage tourism destination.

title: Saudi Arabia Formally Condemns Drone Strike on Khartoum International Airport
detail: Saudi Arabia issued a formal condemnation of a drone attack targeting Khartoum International Airport in Sudan, reaffirming its position calling for the preservation of Sudan's unity, stability, and sovereignty. The statement underscored Saudi Arabia's ongoing diplomatic role in the Sudanese civil war, where Riyadh has sought to mediate between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Saudi Arabia hosted the Jeddah Process talks for Sudan in 2023, and Riyadh has maintained consistent calls for a ceasefire and humanitarian access. The airport attack represented a major escalation in the long-running Sudan conflict.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia issues formal condemnation of drone attack on Khartoum's international airport amid Sudan civil war
